name: Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC)
description: Calculates the blended hurdle rate of return a firm must earn on its existing asset base to satisfy debt holders and equity shareholders.
key_variables: E = Market Value of Equity, D = Market Value of Debt, V = E + D, r_e = Cost of Equity (CAPM), r_d = Pre-tax Cost of Debt, t = Marginal Tax Rate
usage: Discount rate for Free Cash Flow to Firm (FCFF) multi-stage DCF models.

name: Free Cash Flow to Firm (FCFF)
description: Cash flow available to all capital providers (equity and debt holders) after paying operating expenses, taxes, and funding working capital and capital expenditures.
key_variables: CFO = Cash Flow from Operations, t = Tax Rate, CapEx = Capital Expenditures
usage: Core numerator in Enterprise DCF modeling.

name: Free Cash Flow to Equity (FCFE)
description: Cash flow available exclusively to equity shareholders after servicing all operational needs, reinvestment, and net debt repayments.
key_variables: Net Borrowing = Debt Issued - Debt Repaid
usage: Discounted at the Cost of Equity (r_e) to find Equity Value directly.

name: Residual Income / Economic Value Added (EVA)
description: Economic profit generated by the firm in excess of the opportunity cost of equity capital.
key_variables: r_e = Cost of Equity, Book Value = Common Stockholders' Equity
usage: Edwards-Bell-Ohlson clean surplus valuation for financial and asset-heavy firms.

name: Piotroski F-Score (9-Point Fundamental Solvency)
description: 9 binary criteria evaluating Profitability (ROA, CFO, delta ROA, Accrual), Leverage/Liquidity (delta Leverage, delta Current Ratio, Shares count), and Efficiency (delta Margin, delta Turnover).
key_variables: Score 8-9: Strong Value Buy; Score 0-3: Distressed / Weak
usage: Quality filter in value-oriented stock picking strategies.

name: Beneish M-Score (Earnings Manipulation Index)
description: Mathematical probabilistic model to detect whether a company has manipulated its reported earnings.
key_variables: Threshold: M > -1.78 indicates high probability of accounting manipulation.
usage: Red flag screening in institutional fundamental equity research.

name: DuPont 5-Way ROE Decomposition
description: Decomposes Return on Equity into Tax Burden, Interest Burden, Operating Margin, Asset Turnover, and Financial Leverage.
key_variables: NI = Net Income, EBT = Earnings Before Taxes, EBIT = Operating Income
usage: Identifies the exact operational or leverage drivers of corporate profitability.

name: Human Capital Present Value (Holistic Balance Sheet)
description: Net present value of an individual's expected future labor earnings weighted by survival probability.
key_variables: p(s_t) = Survival probability, w = Annual wage, g = Wage growth, r_f = Risk-free rate, y = Occupational risk premium
usage: Determines economic net worth and portfolio equity/bond allocation.

name: Black-Litterman Implied Equilibrium Returns
description: Reverse-optimized neutral expected return vector derived from market capitalization equilibrium weights.
key_variables: \lambda = \text{Risk aversion coefficient}, \Sigma = \text{Covariance matrix}, w_{mkt} = \text{Market cap weights}
usage: Anchor prior for subjective view blending in institutional asset allocation.

name: Brinson-Fachler Performance Attribution
latex: A_i = (w_i - W_i)(B_i - B), \quad S_i = W_i(R_i - B_i), \quad I_i = (w_i - W_i)(R_i - B_i)
description: Decomposes portfolio active return into Allocation Effect, Selection Effect, and Interaction Effect.
key_variables: w_i = Portfolio weight, W_i = Benchmark weight, R_i = Portfolio sector return, B_i = Benchmark sector return, B = Total benchmark return

name: Macaulay & Modified Duration
description: Measures the interest rate sensitivity of a bond or fixed income portfolio.
key_variables: y = Yield to maturity, k = Compounding frequency per year
usage: Liability-driven investing (LDI) immunization and cash-flow matching.

name: Black-Scholes-Merton European Call Pricing
description: Closed-form analytical pricing formula for European options with continuous dividend yield.
usage: Option valuation, delta-neutral hedging, and volatility surface modeling.
